title: relationships endpoint ignores real data
description: GET /api/v1/accounts/relationships (api.rs:1144-1185) returns hardcoded false for all relationship fields, even though interactions.rs has fully functional build_relationship and build_relationship_remote functions that query follows, blocks, and mutes. Mastodon clients (Ivory, Ice Cubes, Elk) rely on this endpoint to render follow/block/mute button states. The hardcoded response makes all buttons show the wrong state. This was presumably a stub that was never replaced once the real implementation landed in interactions.rs.
